text: SHE WOUND HER WAY UP the long drive to Orchard Hill
go to her parents
she could stop by
driving up to see her mother
she wound her way up the hillside
old stone stable sliding into view from behind a raft of greenery
she lifted her into its saddle
she crested the hill
nesting swallows swooping in and out of their peaks
she parked the Datsun
climbed out
pulling off to the side of the road
before moving on to wherever he was headed
Tony had gone into the bathroom
returning
carried her to bed
she made her way up the flagstone path
She found her mother in the small room off the kitchen
Skyler walked in
the last time she’d visited
she made her way from the laundry porch into the big, sunny kitchen
Kate appeared at the table
settling into the chair
she turned and began walking away
Driving away from Orchard Hill
turning down the road that led to Stony Creek Farm
parking in the graveled lot below the stable
climbing out of her Datsun
taking him over jumps
Skyler walked through the stable
trotted over to the fence
swung down from the saddle
They had reached the grooming area just inside the entrance to the stable
she headed for the tack room
Skyler led Victory Lap to his stall
he wheeled past a barrow full of sweepings
Skyler found Mickey by the double doors that opened onto Stony Creek’s east-facing exposure
Skyler slumped onto the bench
The stable cat hopped onto Skyler’s lap
I just came from the house
